description: This Java class defines a custom exception called SubjectIdInvalidException, used to indicate that a Subject ID is invalid within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class includes constructors, static factory methods, and an internal builder class for creating instances of the exception, with specific emphasis on validating the format of a Subject ID.

classes.name: SubjectIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents an exception for invalid Subject IDs, including static methods for creation and an internal builder class.

classes.name: SubjectIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A static inner class providing a fluent API to build instances of SubjectIdInvalidException, with configurable message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: SubjectIdInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with headers, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method returning a new Builder instance, optionally initialized with a subject ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Static factory method creating an exception with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method creating an exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the schema versions supported by this exception.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated headers.
